name: 6 · Frozen Allotment
rule_text: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane.

levels.title: 6-01 · Cold Open
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Establish economy and cover all five lanes.
levels.joke: The welcome mat says hello, not all-you-can-eat. The snowman says this is a hostile work environment. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-02 · Sun in the Freezer
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Build sun production before doubling your shooters.
levels.joke: Sunlight remains free. The zombie subscription is harder to cancel. Cold storage was never meant to store your seed packets. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-03 · Skating Without Consent
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Local traffic cone promoted to middle management. The skating rink has removed the safety rail for budget reasons. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-04 · Appliance Repair Visit
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: The doctor recommends more brains. Seek a second opinion. The thermostat is now a negotiation partner. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-05 · Snowball Negotiations
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Your delivery is three lanes away and marked delivered. The hot cocoa fund has been diverted to emergency botany. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-06 · Mowers on Thin Ice
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. No mowers. Any breach fails the mission. Also lose no more than 8 plants.
levels.joke: The mowers have requested a mental-health day. The hot cocoa fund has been diverted to emergency botany. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air.

levels.title: 6-07 · Twenty Ice Pots
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Win with at most 20 planting actions, including grafts and rafts.
levels.joke: Twenty plants. Infinite unsolicited gardening opinions. The snowman says this is a hostile work environment. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-08 · Snow Medic Shortcut
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. A new specialist joins the queue. Read its almanac counter before starting.
levels.joke: Turn signals are apparently a living-person feature. The skating rink has removed the safety rail for budget reasons. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-09 · Winter Fuel Reserve
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Hold 4500 unspent sun and clear all waves. Collection continues after the last zombie.
levels.joke: Four thousand sun in savings. Still cannot afford a garden shed. The thermostat is now a negotiation partner. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-10 · Frostbite for Vegetables
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Lose no more than 3 plants to attacks or shoveling. Single-use plants do not count.
levels.joke: The roots have formed a union. Please keep them alive. Cold storage was never meant to store your seed packets. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-11 · Interns in Thermal Socks
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Clear the fast waves within 380 seconds. Speed is not an excuse: lose no more than 10 plants.
levels.joke: An internship with excellent exposure and no pulse. The snowman says this is a hostile work environment. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns.

levels.title: 6-12 · Frozen Dinner Selection
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. The supplied seed menu is fixed. Supplies are borrowed even if not yet unlocked.
levels.joke: The chef insists the menu is a tactical constraint. The skating rink has removed the safety rail for budget reasons.

levels.title: 6-13 · Closed for Defrosting
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Dark crossed tiles cannot be planted. Zombies still travel through them.
levels.joke: These tiles are reserved for a future parking lot. Cold storage was never meant to store your seed packets. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-14 · Snowball Fight Club
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Cover the specialist wave; avoid relying on a single front wall.
levels.joke: This wave has read the terms and conditions. You have not. Cold storage was never meant to store your seed packets. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-15 · Grafting in Mittens
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Create at least 2 grafts and clear the waves. Same-plant twin hybrids count too.
levels.joke: Botany: now with legally questionable welding. The hot cocoa fund has been diverted to emergency botany.

levels.title: 6-16 · Snow Cannon Without Plants
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. No plants or seeds required. Click a board tile to fire a free recharging area cannon.
levels.joke: No plants today. The salad has authorized artillery. The snowman says this is a hostile work environment.

levels.title: 6-17 · Five Cold Cases
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Lose no more than 5 plants. Transformations and deliberate single-use plants are exempt.
levels.joke: Five losses are a tragedy. Six are a failed level. The thermostat is now a negotiation partner. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-18 · Polar Night Picnic
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. No sky sun. Start from the supplied savings and plant your own economy.
levels.joke: Solar power at night: accounting would like a word. The skating rink has removed the safety rail for budget reasons.

levels.title: 6-19 · Medic on Ice
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Summoners and small runners require rear coverage, not just one front tank.
levels.joke: Fresh interns have arrived. Their onboarding is your problem. The skating rink has removed the safety rail for budget reasons. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-20 · Bucket with a Frozen Handle
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Armor soaks projectiles. Save explosives for tightly grouped helmets.
levels.joke: Buckets protect brains, not fragile workplace morale. The thermostat is now a negotiation partner. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-21 · Save the Winter Garden
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. No planting. A mature garden is provided. Protect it; click a damaged plant for a free 1200-HP repair every 3 seconds. Crafted tools are optional.
levels.joke: The garden is already planted. Your job description says keep it that way. The snowman says this is a hostile work environment.

levels.title: 6-22 · Five Thousand Warm Thoughts
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Collect a total of 5000 sun in this battle. Spending does not reduce this total. The house is also off-limits: no breaches.
levels.joke: Collect 4000 sun. Do not stare directly at the counter. Cold storage was never meant to store your seed packets. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-23 · Seed Packet Hypothermia
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Fixed five-seed deck (graft two Pod Shooters into a Twin Pod for double fire) and a total limit of 26 planting actions.
levels.joke: The seeds were packed by a minimalist. The hot cocoa fund has been diverted to emergency botany.

levels.title: 6-24 · The Blizzard Committee
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Long mixed assault. Pace your economy: the waves never stop being polite about it.
levels.joke: The committee has decided to attack simultaneously. The thermostat is now a negotiation partner. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.

levels.title: 6-25 · Furnace Defrost Cycle
levels.briefing: Cold pulses delay all seed cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and slow one zombie lane. Two giant arrivals with a rebuilding window. Counter its special ability, then clear the field.
levels.joke: The giant brought a club. The homeowners association brought a fine. The hot cocoa fund has been diverted to emergency botany. Cardboard Box zombies hide behind others: use low shots, catapults or thorns. Balloons fly over ground plants: bring anti-air. Slingshots target flying plants.
